sloka: अथ रामः तथा श्रुत्वा पितुर् आर्तस्य भाषितम् ।लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा दीनो वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-३४-३९॥
transliteration: atha rāmaḥ tathā śrutvā pitur ārtasya bhāṣitam ।lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā dīno vacanam abravīt ॥2-34-39॥

translations.english: Rama and Lakshmana were sad to hear the words of their anguished father. Rama replies:
